patch_resolves_note: The staged fix patch applies cleanly to the workspace checkout, and the fixed original stays clean on the original PoC while still reaching `next_eof` with the reserved-slack predicate satisfied (`parser_len=32767 < input_len=32768`). The vulnerable original violates that predicate (`32768 < 32768` is false), reaches the same EOF event, and then immediately carries `lexer->pos = lexer->end + 1` into `backup()`, which decrements and dereferences at `lexer->end`.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-side consumption of the copied fuzz buffer and its clipped length: the fuzz-only helper starts config parsing on exactly `len` bytes from `data`.

Root cause. Lexer initialization derives `lexer.end` from the full clipped fuzz length, so for this witness `lexer.end` becomes `static_data + 32768`, the first byte past the copied array. The later EOF lookahead in `peek()` steps back to and inspects that boundary. The staged fix avoids this state by having `config_open_for_fuzzing()` pass `len - 1`.
ASan sink. `backup()` dereferences `lexer->pos` after decrementing from the EOF-lookahead state, and on the witnessed path that pointer equals `static_data + 32768`, one byte past the global buffer.
On the witnessed EOF path, `next()` advances `lexer->pos` past `lexer->end` before returning `\0`, creating the stale boundary-adjacent state later consumed by `backup()`.
nodes.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `next_eof.pos_after_next_offset=32769` and `next_eof.end_offset=32768`, so `next_eof.pos_after_next_offset > next_eof.end_offset`.

edges.description: The parser-visible byte count chosen in `config_open_for_fuzzing()` becomes the `lexer.end` boundary later observed at the EOF `next()` event.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `fuzz_open.parser_len == next_eof.end_offset == 32768`.

edges.description: The EOF lookahead position that `next()` leaves at `lexer.end + 1` is the same `lexer->pos` value carried into `backup()` immediately before the decrement that reaches the sink boundary.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `next_eof.pos_after_next_offset == backup_deref.pos_before_offset == 32769`.
